note: Chequamegon-Nicolet National Forest campground in pine and hardwoods on a quiet northwest finger of 263-acre Boot Lake, a clear lake popular with scuba divers, 5.6 miles south of Townsend; paved roads. A trail links into the Jones Spring Non-Motorized Area, and the Wolf River is nearby for paddling. ATVs, UTVs and golf carts are not driven in the campground. --Claude
summary: rec.gov API, RIDB catalog and FS page read. $18, Apr 30 - Nov 30 (2027 rate seasons Apr 29 - Nov 29), 34 back-in sites 25-45+ ft, reservations only in the summer peak with 13 first-come sites; no hookups, vault toilets, water, beach. WATERFRONT LEAD: lakefront -> lakeview (rec.gov's three Lakefront sites 13-15 are 20-30 m back under pine canopy). FIT QUESTION: rec.gov permits only Tent/Trailer, no RV/motorhome type, on every site.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (down, lakefront -> lakeview; not an --AWH value): rec.gov tags only sites 13 (45.26948,-88.64503), 14 (45.26988,-88.64493) and 15 (45.27020,-88.64489) 'Lakefront'; they sit ~25, ~22 and ~40 m from the shore but under continuous pine canopy on imagery, and site 14's photo shows the lake through tall pine trunks. Site 6 (45.26850,-88.64472, ~15 m from the water) is in dense tree cover and its photo shows no water. Under the canopy rule this is a view. If the reviewer reads the open pine floor as an apron, 13-15 (13 and 15 first-come, 14 reservable; all nightly) are the sites a lakefront caveat would name.

FIT QUESTION: every RIDB site lists permitted equipment 'Tent, Trailer' only (site 5 lists none); no RV/motorhome type anywhere. The FS page says 'A majority of campsites can accommodate campers as long as 35 feet and longer' and has an 'RV Camping' section, so this looks like a catalog data gap, but EKKO books as a motorhome: worth checking the booking flow.

SITES: FS page says 36 campsites/19 reservable; rec.gov description says 34 and the catalog holds 33 (no site 2). The FS size list covers sites 1-34, so count 34 is kept. FS lists site 11 as reservable while the rec.gov notice lists it as first-come (catalog: reservable).
SEASON: stored manual 04-30/11-30 confirmed; 2027 rate seasons run 04-29 to 11-29.
PIN: 45.2685,-88.6457 is at the south end of the loops near sites 1/3; centroid of the catalog sites is ~45.2690,-88.6460 (~60 m). Fine.
STATUS: seasonal; nothing posted beyond the season.
